# `studio` — `/api/studio`

Studio router — manages MusicStudio sidecars and proxies requests to them.

| Method | Path | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| POST | [`/api/studio/effects/chain`](#post-api-studio-effects-chain) | Apply a JSON-encoded Pedalboard effects chain to an audio file. |
| POST | [`/api/studio/effects/master`](#post-api-studio-effects-master) | Master a target audio track to match the loudness/EQ of a reference track. |
| GET | [`/api/studio/sidecars`](#get-api-studio-sidecars) | Return status of all MusicStudio sidecar processes. |
| POST | [`/api/studio/sidecars/{sidecar_id}/start`](#post-api-studio-sidecars-sidecar-id-start) | Launch a sidecar subprocess from its MusicStudio venv. |
| POST | [`/api/studio/sidecars/{sidecar_id}/stop`](#post-api-studio-sidecars-sidecar-id-stop) | Terminate a running sidecar process. |
| POST | [`/api/studio/stems`](#post-api-studio-stems) | Submit an audio file for stem separation; returns a job ID. |
| GET | [`/api/studio/stems/{job_id}`](#get-api-studio-stems-job-id) | Poll the status of a stem separation job. |
| GET | [`/api/studio/stems/{job_id}/{stem_name}`](#get-api-studio-stems-job-id-stem-name) | Download a completed stem as a WAV file. |
| POST | [`/api/studio/voice/convert`](#post-api-studio-voice-convert) | Submit audio for RVC voice conversion; returns a job ID. |
| GET | [`/api/studio/voice/convert/{job_id}`](#get-api-studio-voice-convert-job-id) | Poll the status of a voice conversion job. |
| GET | [`/api/studio/voice/convert/{job_id}/result`](#get-api-studio-voice-convert-job-id-result) | Download the converted audio as a WAV file. |
| GET | [`/api/studio/voice/models`](#get-api-studio-voice-models) | List available RVC voice conversion models. |
| POST | [`/api/studio/voice/models/import`](#post-api-studio-voice-models-import) | Accept .pth (+ optional .index) upload, save to MusicStudio models dir, then register with sidecar. |
| DELETE | [`/api/studio/voice/models/{name}`](#delete-api-studio-voice-models-name) | Remove a voice model from the sidecar. |
| GET | [`/api/studio/voice/status`](#get-api-studio-voice-status) | Return RVC voice sidecar status and loaded model. |

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |

| `audio` | file | yes |  |  |

**Response**
